intro.text: A kandra explorer whose photographs and missing spike prompt a search for the Bands of Mourning.
A Third Generation kandra, one of the few of his generation still alive after the Catacendre, and an honored elder among his people.

items.text: ReLuur photographed murals showing bracers on a pedestal, a statue like the Lord Ruler and writing in an unknown script. He came back from his expedition with a spike missing, unable to say what he had seen or what had happened to him.
